sources.name: Google Business Profile Help
sources.note: Product help and release notes. The primary source for feature and policy changes.

sources.name: Google Business Profile — guidelines
sources.note: The representation guidelines. Read these properly once a year — lesson 10.3.1.

sources.name: Google Search Central Blog
sources.note: Announcements including ranking and local changes. Has an RSS feed, so it is checked automatically.

sources.name: Google Search Status Dashboard
sources.note: Confirms live incidents and ongoing ranking updates. Check this first when many businesses move at once.

sources.name: Google Business Profile Help Community
sources.note: Product experts and Google staff post announcements and confirm behaviour here.

sources.name: Search Engine Roundtable
sources.note: Third party. Fast on local changes. Treat early reports as unconfirmed — lesson 8.4.3.

sources.name: Search Engine Land
sources.note: Third party. Usually slower but more measured than immediate forum reports.
